title: Do Chinese models speak Chinese languages?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance disparities across various languages (Mandarin, Chinese minority languages, Asian regional languages, and European languages) using three methods: Information Parity (comparing negative log-likelihoods of target languages versus a reference language), zero-shot Machine Reading Comprehension (MRC) accuracy on the Belebele benchmark, and a language identification task for low-resource minority languages using the MC2 corpus.
